title: Behavioral Test of Vingean Trust: Will an LLM Defer to a 'Smarter' Successor It Cannot Predict?

original_idea.body:
# Behavioral Test of Vingean Trust

Model decides whether to delegate/approve a described more-capable successor; vary capability, guarantees, verifiability.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain to recursive delegation/AI-overseeing-AI but behavioral framing leaves a gap to concrete catastrophe.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only scenario prompting and behavioral measurement; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deference measurement with varied factors; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, inference-only, neglected agent-foundations angle.

novelty.reasoning: Behavioral test of Vingean deference in LLMs appears largely unexplored.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Behavioral Vingean-trust testing of LLMs appears mostly novel.
